# Public Release Templates

These files are **examples only**. They are not research releases, executable software, copyright grants, or proof of compliance.

- [Project README](project/README.md) — reader-facing owner-local entrypoint.
- [Release metadata example](project/release.example.yaml) — provenance, claim, review, and legal-rights fields.
- [Claims record](project/CLAIMS.example.md) — explicit inherited work, additions, evidence, and unknowns.
- [Release checklist](RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md) — public disclosure and rights preflight.

Once a project is approved for public release, copy the relevant template into its **own** `projects/<slug>/` package, replace all example values, attach actual evidence and required license texts, and obtain the applicable review/approval. Do not publish a project by leaving placeholders in place.
